**Example Refactor: Upload Endpoint**

**BEFORE ([index.js](backend/index.js#L62-L99)):**
```javascript
app.post("/api/admin/upload", upload.single("file"), async (req, res) => {
  const schema = z.object({
    title: z.string().min(1),
    speaker: z.string().min(1),
    date: z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/)
  });

  const parsed = schema.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!parsed.success) return res.status(400).json({ error: "Invalid fields" });
  if (!req.file) return res.status(400).json({ error: "Missing file" });

  const id = nanoid();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  const { storageKey } = await blob.putAudio({
    id,
    date: parsed.data.date,
    originalName: req.file.originalname,
    mimetype: req.file.mimetype,
    buffer: req.file.buffer,
  });

  await db.insertSermon({
    id,
    title: parsed.data.title,
    speaker: parsed.data.speaker,
    date: parsed.data.date,
    filename: req.file.originalname,
    storageKey,
    mimetype: req.file.mimetype,
    size: req.file.size,
    durationSeconds: null,
    createdAt: now,
  });

  res.json({ ok: true, id });
});
```

**AFTER (Layered):**

```javascript
// api/routes/admin.js
router.post('/upload', 
  authenticateToken,           // NEW: JWT verification
  authorizeRole('admin'),      // NEW: RBAC
  rateLimit({ max: 10 }),      // NEW: Rate limiting
  upload.single('file'),
  AdminController.uploadSermon
);

// api/controllers/AdminController.js
class AdminController {
  static async uploadSermon(req, res, next) {
    try {
      const uploadDto = {
        title: req.body.title,
        speaker: req.body.speaker,
        date: req.body.date,
        file: req.file,
        uploadedBy: req.user.id  // From JWT
      };

      const sermon = await uploadService.createSermon(uploadDto);
      
      // Event: sermon.created
      await eventBus.publish('sermon.created', { sermonId: sermon.id });

      res.status(201).json({ 
        data: sermon.toJSON(),
        message: 'Sermon uploaded successfully' 
      });
    } catch (error) {
      next(error);  // Centralized error handler
    }
  }
}

// services/UploadService.js
class UploadService {
  constructor(sermonRepo, storageAdapter, logger) {
    this.sermonRepo = sermonRepo;
    this.storage = storageAdapter;
    this.logger = logger;
  }

  async createSermon(uploadDto) {
    // 1. Validate DTO
    const validatedData = await this.validateUpload(uploadDto);
    
    // 2. Virus scan (NEW)
    await this.scanForMalware(uploadDto.file.buffer);
    
    // 3. Store file
    const storageKey = await this.storage.putAudio({
      id: validatedData.id,
      date: validatedData.date,
      file: uploadDto.file
    });
    
    // 4. Create domain object
    const sermon = new Sermon({
      ...validatedData,
      storageKey,
      uploadedBy: uploadDto.uploadedBy
    });
    
    // 5. Persist
    await this.sermonRepo.save(sermon);
    
    // 6. Log
    this.logger.info('Sermon created', { sermonId: sermon.id });
    
    return sermon;
  }
}

// domain/Sermon.js
class Sermon {
  constructor(data) {
    this.id = data.id || nanoid();
    this.title = data.title;
    this.speaker = new Speaker(data.speaker);  // Value object
    this.date = new SermonDate(data.date);     // Value object with validation
    this.storageKey = data.storageKey;
    this.metadata = new AudioMetadata(data);
    this.createdAt = data.createdAt || new Date();
    this.uploadedBy = data.uploadedBy;
    
    this.validate();  // Self-validation
  }

  validate() {
    if (!this.title || this.title.trim().length === 0) {
      throw new ValidationError('Title is required');
    }
    if (this.title.length > 200) {
      throw new ValidationError('Title too long');
    }
    // ... more validation
  }

  toJSON() {
    return {
      id: this.id,
      title: this.title,
      speaker: this.speaker.name,
      date: this.date.toISO(),
      // ... etc
    };
  }
}
```

### 🔐 AGENT 3: SECURITY ANALYSIS (CRITICAL)

#### OWASP Top 10 (2021) Assessment

| OWASP Risk | Status | Findings | Severity |
|------------|--------|----------|----------|
| **A01: Broken Access Control** | ❌ FAIL | No authentication on admin routes | **CRITICAL** |
| **A02: Cryptographic Failures** | ⚠️ PARTIAL | No encryption at rest, Postgres SSL optional | **HIGH** |
| **A03: Injection** | ⚠️ PARTIAL | SQL parameterized, but no input sanitization | **MEDIUM** |
| **A04: Insecure Design** | ❌ FAIL | No threat modeling, no security requirements | **HIGH** |
| **A05: Security Misconfiguration** | ❌ FAIL | Docker runs as root, CORS misconfigured | **HIGH** |

| **A07: Identity & Auth Failures** | ❌ FAIL | No auth implemented | **CRITICAL** |

| **A10: SSRF** | ✅ PASS | No external URL fetching | **N/A** |

#### Detailed Security Findings

**1. CRITICAL: No Authentication/Authorization**

**Location:** [index.js](backend/index.js#L62)  
**Issue:**
```javascript
app.post("/api/admin/upload", upload.single("file"), async (req, res) => {
  // Anyone can upload 200MB files
```

**Attack Scenario:**
```bash
# Attacker fills your S3 bucket with garbage
for i in {1..1000}; do
  curl -X POST http://your-api.com/api/admin/upload \
    -F "file=@/dev/urandom" \
    -F "title=Junk$i" \
    -F "speaker=Hacker" \
    -F "date=2026-01-01"
done

# Result: $$$$ in S3 costs, service DOS
```

**Remediation:**
```javascript
// 1. Implement JWT-based authentication
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import jwksClient from 'jwks-rsa';

const client = jwksClient({
  jwksUri: `https://cognito-idp.${region}.amazonaws.com/${userPoolId}/.well-known/jwks.json`
});

async function authenticateToken(req, res, next) {
  const token = req.headers.authorization?.split(' ')[1];
  if (!token) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'No token provided' });

  try {
    const decoded = jwt.verify(token, getKey, { algorithms: ['RS256'] });
    req.user = decoded;
    next();
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid token' });
  }
}

function authorizeRole(role) {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    if (!req.user.groups?.includes(role)) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Forbidden' });
    }
    next();
  };
}

app.post("/api/admin/upload", 
  authenticateToken, 
  authorizeRole('admin'),
  upload.single("file"), 
  async (req, res) => { /* ... */ }
);
```

**2. CRITICAL: File Upload Vulnerabilities**

**Location:** [index.js](backend/index.js#L26-L32)

**Issues:**
a) **MIME type bypass:**
```javascript
fileFilter: (_req, file, cb) => {
  if (!file.mimetype.startsWith("audio/")) return cb(new Error("Only audio files allowed"));
  cb(null, true);
}
```
Attacker can spoof MIME type:
```bash
curl -X POST /api/admin/upload \
  -F "file=@malware.exe;type=audio/mpeg"  # ← MIME type faked
```

b) **No content validation:** File extension not checked, no magic number verification

c) **No virus scanning:** Malware could be uploaded and served to users

**Remediation:**
```javascript
import crypto from 'crypto';
import fileType from 'file-type';
import { ClamAV } from 'clamav.js';

async function validateAudioFile(buffer) {
  // 1. Magic number check
  const type = await fileType.fromBuffer(buffer);
  const allowedTypes = ['audio/mpeg', 'audio/mp4', 'audio/ogg', 'audio/wav'];
  
  if (!type || !allowedTypes.includes(type.mime)) {
    throw new ValidationError('Invalid audio format');
  }

  // 2. Virus scan
  const clamav = new ClamAV();
  const scanResult = await clamav.scanBuffer(buffer);
  if (scanResult.isInfected) {
    logger.warn('Malware detected', { virus: scanResult.viruses });
    throw new SecurityError('File contains malware');
  }

  // 3. Size validation
  if (buffer.length > 200 * 1024 * 1024) {
    throw new ValidationError('File too large');
  }

  return true;
}
```

**3. HIGH: SQL Injection Risk (Partial)**

**Location:** [adapters/db/sqlite.js](backend/adapters/db/sqlite.js#L40-L45)

**Current (Safe):**
```javascript
const rows = db.prepare(`
  SELECT id, title, speaker, date
  FROM sermons
  ${whereSql}
  ${orderSql}
  LIMIT 200
`).all(params);  // ✅ Parameterized
```

**Risk:** Sort parameter not validated:
```javascript
if (sort === "date_asc") orderSql = "ORDER BY date ASC";
if (sort === "title_asc") orderSql = "ORDER BY title ASC";
// What if sort = "date; DROP TABLE sermons;--" ?
```

**Remediation:**
```javascript
const ALLOWED_SORTS = {
  'date_desc': 'ORDER BY date DESC',
  'date_asc': 'ORDER BY date ASC',
  'title_asc': 'ORDER BY title ASC',
  'title_desc': 'ORDER BY title DESC'
};

const orderSql = ALLOWED_SORTS[sort] || 'ORDER BY date DESC';
```

**4. HIGH: Secrets Management**

**Location:** [config.js](backend/config.js#L20-L24)

**Issue:**
```javascript
DB_PASSWORD: env.DB_PASSWORD,  // ← Plain env var
```

Secrets stored in plaintext in:
- `.env` files (likely in git history)
- Docker Compose files
- GitHub Actions secrets (better, but not rotated)

**Remediation:**
```javascript
// Use AWS Secrets Manager
import { SecretsManagerClient, GetSecretValueCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-secrets-manager';

async function getSecret(secretName) {
  const client = new SecretsManagerClient({ region: config.AWS_REGION });
  const response = await client.send(
    new GetSecretValueCommand({ SecretId: secretName })
  );
  return JSON.parse(response.SecretString);
}

// In config.js
const dbCreds = await getSecret(`${env}/jummahcast/db`);
return {
  // ...
  DB_PASSWORD: dbCreds.password,  // ← From Secrets Manager
  DB_USER: dbCreds.username,
  // Secrets auto-rotate via Lambda
};
```

**Terraform:**
```terraform
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "db_password" {
  name                    = "${var.env}/jummahcast/db"
  recovery_window_in_days = 7  # 7-day recovery window
}

resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_rotation" "db_password" {
  secret_id           = aws_secretsmanager_secret.db_password.id
  rotation_lambda_arn = aws_lambda_function.rotate_secret.arn

  rotation_rules {
    automatically_after_days = 30
  }
}
```

**5. HIGH: Docker Security Issues**

**Location:** [dockerfile](backend/dockerfile)

**Issues:**

a) **Running as root:**
```dockerfile
# No USER directive = runs as root
CMD ["node", "index.js"]
```

b) **Untrusted base image:**
```dockerfile
FROM dhi.io/node:25-alpine3.22 AS runtime  # ← What is dhi.io?
```

c) **Commented healthcheck:**
```dockerfile
# HEALTHCHECK --interval=5m --timeout=3s \
#   CMD curl -f http://localhost:4000/health || exit 1
```

**Remediation:**
```dockerfile
FROM node:25.2.1-alpine AS build  # ← Official image only

WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production

FROM node:25.2.1-alpine AS runtime

# Security: Run as non-root user
RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S nodejs && \
    adduser -S nodejs -u 1001

WORKDIR /app

# Copy with correct ownership
COPY --from=build --chown=nodejs:nodejs /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --chown=nodejs:nodejs . .

# Switch to non-root user
USER nodejs

EXPOSE 4000

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
  CMD node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:4000/health', (r) => process.exit(r.statusCode === 200 ? 0 : 1))"

CMD ["node", "index.js"]
```

**6. MEDIUM: CORS Misconfiguration**

**Location:** [config.js](backend/config.js#L7-L11)

**Issue:**
```javascript
CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: (env.CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS ||
  "http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:4173")  // ← Hardcoded localhost
```

In production, this needs to be:
- Production domain (https://jummahcast.com)
- NO wildcards (avoid `*`)
- Credentials support if using cookies

**Remediation:**
```javascript
// config.js
const allowedOrigins = env.CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(',').map(s => s.trim()) || [];

// Validation
for (const origin of allowedOrigins) {
  if (!origin.match(/^https?:\/\//)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid CORS origin: ${origin}`);
  }
}

// index.js
app.use(cors({
  origin: (origin, callback) => {
    if (!origin || allowedOrigins.includes(origin)) {
      callback(null, true);
    } else {
      logger.warn('CORS violation', { origin });
      callback(new Error('Not allowed by CORS'));
    }
  },
  credentials: true,
  maxAge: 86400  // Cache preflight for 1 day
}));
```

**7. MEDIUM: No Rate Limiting**

**Attack Scenario:**
```bash
# Brute force admin login (when implemented)
for pw in $(cat passwords.txt); do
  curl -X POST /api/admin/login -d "{\"password\":\"$pw\"}"
done

# Search query DOS
while true; do
  curl '/api/sermons?q=xxxxxxxxxxxxx'
done
```

**Remediation:**
```javascript
import rateLimit from 'express-rate-limit';
import RedisStore from 'rate-limit-redis';
import Redis from 'ioredis';

const redis = new Redis(process.env.REDIS_URL);

// Global rate limit
const globalLimiter = rateLimit({
  store: new RedisStore({ client: redis }),
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,  // 15 minutes
  max: 100,  // 100 requests per 15 min
  standardHeaders: true,
  legacyHeaders: false,
  handler: (req, res) => {
    res.status(429).json({ error: 'Too many requests' });
  }
});

// Strict limiter for auth endpoints
const authLimiter = rateLimit({
  store: new RedisStore({ client: redis }),
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  max: 5,  // 5 attempts per 15 min
  skipSuccessfulRequests: true
});

// Upload rate limit (per user)
const uploadLimiter = rateLimit({
  store: new RedisStore({ client: redis }),
  windowMs: 60 * 60 * 1000,  // 1 hour
  max: 10,  // 10 uploads per hour
  keyGenerator: (req) => req.user.id  // Per authenticated user
});

app.use('/api', globalLimiter);
app.use('/api/admin/login', authLimiter);
app.use('/api/admin/upload', uploadLimiter);
```

**Requires adding Redis to infrastructure:**
```terraform
resource "aws_elasticache_cluster" "redis" {
  cluster_id           = "${var.project}-${var.env}-redis"
  engine               = "redis"
  node_type            = "cache.t4g.micro"
  num_cache_nodes      = 1
  parameter_group_name = "default.redis7"
  port                 = 6379
  subnet_group_name    = aws_elasticache_subnet_group.redis.name
  security_group_ids   = [aws_security_group.redis.id]
}
```

**8. MEDIUM: No Input Sanitization**

**Location:** [index.js](backend/index.js#L41-L44)

**Issue:**
```javascript
const q = (req.query.q || "").toString().trim();
const speaker = (req.query.speaker || "").toString().trim();
// No length limits, no XSS prevention
```

**Attack:**
```bash
curl '/api/sermons?q=<script>alert("XSS")</script>'
# Reflected in logs, potential stored XSS if displayed
```

**Remediation:**
```javascript
import validator from 'validator';
import { z } from 'zod';

const searchSchema = z.object({
  q: z.string().max(100).optional(),
  speaker: z.string().max(100).optional(),
  sort: z.enum(['date_desc', 'date_asc', 'title_asc', 'title_desc']).optional()
});

app.get("/api/sermons", async (req, res) => {
  const parsed = searchSchema.safeParse(req.query);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid query parameters' });
  }

  const { q, speaker, sort } = parsed.data;

  // Sanitize for display (prevent XSS)
  const sanitizedQ = q ? validator.escape(q) : '';
  const sanitizedSpeaker = speaker ? validator.escape(speaker) : '';

  const items = await db.listSermons({ 
    q: sanitizedQ, 
    speaker: sanitizedSpeaker, 
    sort 
  });
  res.json({ items });
});
```

#### Security Architecture Recommendations

**1. Defense in Depth (Layered Security):**

```
Client (React)
  ↓
CloudFront (WAF, DDoS protection)
  ↓
ALB (TLS termination, header injection prevention)
  ↓
API Gateway (Throttling, API key validation)
  ↓
ECS/Fargate (Container isolation, secrets via SSM)
  ↓
VPC (Private subnets, Security Groups, NACLs)
  ↓
RDS (Encryption at rest, IAM auth, VPC isolation)
S3 (Bucket policies, encryption, versioning)
```

**2. IAM Principle of Least Privilege:**

```terraform
# ECS Task Role (runtime permissions)
resource "aws_iam_role" "ecs_task" {
  name = "${var.project}-${var.env}-ecs-task"

  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Action = "sts:AssumeRole"
      Principal = {
        Service = "ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com"
      }
      Effect = "Allow"
    }]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "s3_upload" {
  role = aws_iam_role.ecs_task.id

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Effect = "Allow"
      Action = [
        "s3:PutObject",
        "s3:GetObject"
      ]
      Resource = "${aws_s3_bucket.sermons.arn}/sermons/*"
      # NO DeleteObject, NO ListBucket on root
    }]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "secrets" {
  role = aws_iam_role.ecs_task.id

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Effect = "Allow"
      Action = [
        "secretsmanager:GetSecretValue"
      ]
      Resource = [
        aws_secretsmanager_secret.db_password.arn
      ]
      # NO PutSecretValue, NO DeleteSecret
    }]
  })
}
```

**3. Encryption Everywhere:**

| Data State | Current | Required |
|------------|---------|----------|
| In Transit | HTTP (local) | TLS 1.3 (ALB → ECS, RDS, S3) |
| At Rest (DB) | None (SQLite) | RDS encryption with KMS CMK |
| At Rest (Storage) | None (local) | S3 SSE-KMS |
| Secrets | Env vars | AWS Secrets Manager |
| Backups | None | Encrypted RDS snapshots (KMS) |

**Terraform:**
```terraform
resource "aws_kms_key" "jummahcast" {
  description             = "JummahCast encryption key"
  deletion_window_in_days = 10

}

resource "aws_db_instance" "postgres" {

    value = "1"

}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration" "sermons" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.sermons.id

  rule {
    apply_server_side_encryption_by_default {
      sse_algorithm     = "aws:kms"
      kms_master_key_id = aws_kms_key.jummahcast.arn

**schema/init.sql:**

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sermons (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    speaker TEXT NOT NULL,
    date DATE NOT NULL,
    filename TEXT NOT NULL,
    storage_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    mimetype TEXT NOT NULL,
    size BIGINT NOT NULL,
    duration_seconds INTEGER,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    uploaded_by TEXT  -- Foreign key to users table (future)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_sermons_speaker ON sermons(speaker);
CREATE INDEX idx_sermons_date ON sermons(date DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_sermons_title ON sermons(title);
CREATE INDEX idx_sermons_created_at ON sermons(created_at DESC);

-- Full-text search (for future)
CREATE INDEX idx_sermons_search ON sermons USING gin(
    to_tsvector('english', title || ' ' || speaker)
);

-- Trigger for updated_at
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    NEW.updated_at = NOW();
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER update_sermons_updated_at
    BEFORE UPDATE ON sermons
    FOR EACH ROW
    EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();

  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.sermons.id

  block_public_acls       = true
  block_public_policy     = true
  ignore_public_acls      = true
  restrict_public_buckets = true
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration" "sermons" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.sermons.id

  rule {
    id     = "archive-old-versions"
    status = "Enabled"

    noncurrent_version_transition {
      noncurrent_days = 30
      storage_class   = "GLACIER"
    }

    noncurrent_version_expiration {
      noncurrent_days = 90  # Delete old versions after 90 days
    }
  }

  rule {
    id     = "transition-to-ia"
    status = "Enabled"

    transition {
      days          = 90  # Files not accessed in 90 days → Infrequent Access
      storage_class = "STANDARD_IA"
    }
  }
}

# Bucket policy: Allow CloudFront OAC + ECS Task Role
resource "aws_s3_bucket_policy" "sermons" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.sermons.id

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Sid    = "AllowCloudFrontOAC"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Principal = {
          Service = "cloudfront.amazonaws.com"
        }
        Action   = "s3:GetObject"
        Resource = "${aws_s3_bucket.sermons.arn}/*"
        Condition = {
          StringEquals = {
            "AWS:SourceArn" = aws_cloudfront_distribution.cdn.arn
          }
        }
      },
      {
        Sid    = "AllowECSTaskRole"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Principal = {
          AWS = aws_iam_role.ecs_task.arn
        }
        Action = [
          "s3:PutObject",
          "s3:GetObject"
        ]
        Resource = "${aws_s3_bucket.sermons.arn}/sermons/*"
      }
    ]
  })
}
```

resource "aws_lb" "main" {

# HTTP → HTTPS redirect

    type = "redirect"

# HTTPS listener

**5. No CDN (CloudFront)**

```terraform
resource "aws_cloudfront_origin_access_control" "s3" {
  name                              = "${var.project}-${var.env}-oac"
  origin_access_control_origin_type = "s3"
  signing_behavior                  = "always"
  signing_protocol                  = "sigv4"
}

resource "aws_cloudfront_distribution" "cdn" {
  enabled             = true
  is_ipv6_enabled     = true
  comment             = "JummahCast CDN - ${var.env}"
  default_root_object = "index.html"
  price_class         = var.env == "prod" ? "PriceClass_All" : "PriceClass_100"

  # Origin 1: S3 (audio files)
  origin {
    domain_name              = aws_s3_bucket.sermons.bucket_regional_domain_name
    origin_id                = "S3-Sermons"
    origin_access_control_id = aws_cloudfront_origin_access_control.s3.id

    origin_shield {
      enabled              = var.env == "prod" ? true : false
      origin_shield_region = var.region
    }
  }

  # Origin 2: ALB (API)
  origin {
    domain_name = aws_lb.main.dns_name
    origin_id   = "ALB-API"

    custom_origin_config {
      http_port              = 80
      https_port             = 443
      origin_protocol_policy = "https-only"
      origin_ssl_protocols   = ["TLSv1.2"]
    }
  }

  # Behavior 1: API requests
  ordered_cache_behavior {
    path_pattern     = "/api/*"
    target_origin_id = "ALB-API"

    allowed_methods  = ["GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS", "PUT", "POST", "PATCH", "DELETE"]
    cached_methods   = ["GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"]
    compress         = true

    viewer_protocol_policy = "https-only"
    min_ttl                = 0
    default_ttl            = 0
    max_ttl                = 0  # Don't cache API responses

    forwarded_values {
      query_string = true
      headers      = ["Authorization", "Origin"]

      cookies {
        forward = "all"
      }
    }
  }

  # Behavior 2: Sermon streaming (S3)
  ordered_cache_behavior {
    path_pattern     = "/sermons/*"
    target_origin_id = "S3-Sermons"

    allowed_methods  = ["GET", "HEAD"]
    cached_methods   = ["GET", "HEAD"]
    compress         = false  # Audio already compressed

    viewer_protocol_policy = "https-only"
    min_ttl                = 86400   # 1 day
    default_ttl            = 604800  # 7 days
    max_ttl                = 31536000  # 1 year

    forwarded_values {
      query_string = false

      cookies {
        forward = "none"
      }
    }
  }

  # Default behavior: Frontend (S3)
  default_cache_behavior {
    target_origin_id = "S3-Frontend"  # (Need to add frontend origin)

    allowed_methods  = ["GET", "HEAD"]
    cached_methods   = ["GET", "HEAD"]
    compress         = true

    viewer_protocol_policy = "redirect-to-https"
    min_ttl                = 0
    default_ttl            = 3600    # 1 hour
    max_ttl                = 86400   # 1 day

    forwarded_values {
      query_string = false

      cookies {
        forward = "none"
      }
    }
  }

  restrictions {
    geo_restriction {
      restriction_type = "none"
    }
  }

  viewer_certificate {
    acm_certificate_arn      = aws_acm_certificate.main.arn  # Must be us-east-1!
    ssl_support_method       = "sni-only"
    minimum_protocol_version = "TLSv1.2_2021"
  }

  web_acl_id = aws_wafv2_web_acl.main.arn  # WAF protection

  logging_config {
    bucket          = aws_s3_bucket.cloudfront_logs.bucket_domain_name
    include_cookies = false
    prefix          = "cloudfront/"
  }

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project}-${var.env}-cdn"
  }
}

  validation_method = "DNS"

  subject_alternative_names = [
    "www.${var.domain_name}",
    "api.${var.domain_name}"

    create_before_destroy = true

  tags = {

  }

resource "aws_route53_record" "cert_validation" {
  for_each = {
    for dvo in aws_acm_certificate.main.domain_validation_options : dvo.domain_name => {
      name   = dvo.resource_record_name
      record = dvo.resource_record_value
      type   = dvo.resource_record_type
    }
  }

  allow_overwrite = true
  name            = each.value.name
  records         = [each.value.record]
  ttl             = 60
  type            = each.value.type
  zone_id         = aws_route53_zone.main.zone_id
}
```

# 🔍 JUMMAHCAST-APP: COMPREHENSIVE SYSTEM AUDIT

**Audit Date:** March 21, 2026  
**System Type:** Audio Streaming Platform for Religious Content  
**Current Stage:** MVP / Early Development

---

## 1. SYSTEM OVERVIEW

### Current State
JummahCast-App is a **monolithic web application** for streaming and managing Jummah (Friday prayer) lectures. The system uses:

- **Frontend:** React 19 + Vite (SPA)
- **Backend:** Node.js + Express (REST API)
- **Database:** Adapter pattern (SQLite for local, PostgreSQL for production)
- **Storage:** Adapter pattern (Local filesystem or AWS S3)
- **Infrastructure:** Partial AWS deployment via Terraform (VPC only)
- **Containerization:** Docker (backend only)
- **CI/CD:** GitHub Actions (build + push to ECR)

### Architecture Diagram (Current)

### Key Characteristics
- **Deployment Model:** Local development only, AWS infra incomplete
- **State:** Stateful (stores files locally or expects S3)
- **Scale:** Single-instance, no horizontal scaling capability
- **Auth:** None (commented "Coming next: Cognito")
- **Public Access:** Not production-ready

## 2. 🚨 CRITICAL ISSUES (Top 10)

| # | Issue | Severity | Impact | Component |
|---|-------|----------|--------|-----------|
| 1 | **No Authentication/Authorization** | CRITICAL | Anyone can upload 200MB files, DOS attack vector | Backend API |
| 2 | **Missing Input Validation on Upload** | CRITICAL | File type bypass, malicious uploads, injection risks | /api/admin/upload |
| 3 | **No Rate Limiting** | CRITICAL | Resource exhaustion, costs spiralling (S3/RDS) | Backend |
| 4 | **Incomplete Infrastructure** | CRITICAL | Cannot deploy to production, no compute/storage | Terraform |
| 5 | **Hardcoded CORS Origins** | HIGH | Cannot change without rebuild, security risk | config.js |
| 6 | **No Logging/Monitoring** | HIGH | Cannot debug production issues, no observability | Entire system |
| 7 | **No Database Migration Strategy** | HIGH | Manual schema changes break deployment | DB layer |
| 8 | **Docker Security Issues** | HIGH | Running as root, commented healthcheck, image from untrusted registry | Dockerfile |
| 9 | **No Secrets Management** | HIGH | DB passwords in env vars, no rotation, no vault | Config |
| 10 | **Missing Error Handling** | MEDIUM | Crashes expose stack traces, poor UX | Backend routes |

## 3. 🧩 AGENT REPORTS

### 🧱 AGENT 1: ARCHITECTURE ANALYSIS

#### Current Architecture Pattern
**Monolithic N-Tier with Adapter Pattern**
- Presentation (React SPA)
- API Layer (Express REST)
- Business Logic (Minimal, in route handlers)
- Data Access (Adapter abstraction over SQLite/Postgres)
- Infrastructure (Adapter abstraction over Local/S3)

#### Findings

**✅ Strengths:**
1. **Clean adapter pattern** for database and storage portability
2. **Separation of concerns** between frontend/backend
3. **Environment-driven configuration** allows dev/prod parity
4. **Simple data model** appropriate for MVP scope

**❌ Weaknesses:**

1. **Fat Controllers Anti-Pattern**
   - All business logic in route handlers ([index.js](backend/index.js#L41-L99))
   - No service layer, no domain models
   - Violates Single Responsibility Principle

2. **No Domain Layer**
   - Missing entities: `Sermon`, `Speaker`, `User`
   - No validation logic encapsulation
   - Database models directly exposed to HTTP layer

3. **Tight Coupling**
   - Frontend directly constructs stream URLs ([api.js](frontend/src/lib/api.js#L20))
   - No API versioning (`/api/v1/...`)
   - Hard to evolve without breaking changes

4. **Missing Architectural Components:**
   - No message queue (for async processing like thumbnails, transcription)
   - No caching layer (Redis for sermon metadata, speaker lists)
   - No CDN integration (CloudFront for audio streaming)
   - No search engine (Elasticsearch for full-text search)

5. **Scalability Issues:**
   - Stateful local storage violates 12-factor app
   - No session management (future auth will be problematic)
   - Database connection pooling config is hardcoded

6. **Infrastructure Gaps:**
   - VPC exists but no compute resources
   - No IaC for RDS, S3, ECS, ALB, Route53
   - No multi-AZ deployment
   - No disaster recovery plan

#### Architecture Recommendations

**Immediate (Phase 1):**
```
Monolith Refactor with Layered Architecture:

frontend/
backend/
  ├── src/
  │   ├── domain/          # Entities & value objects
  │   │   ├── Sermon.js
  │   │   ├── Speaker.js
  │   │   └── User.js
  │   ├── services/        # Business logic
  │   │   ├── SermonService.js
  │   │   └── AuthService.js
  │   ├── repositories/    # Data access
  │   │   └── SermonRepository.js
  │   ├── adapters/        # External integrations
  │   │   ├── db/
  │   │   └── storage/
  │   ├── api/             # HTTP layer
  │   │   ├── routes/
  │   │   ├── middleware/
  │   │   └── controllers/
  │   └── infrastructure/  # Config, logging
```

**Medium-term (Phase 2):**
- Extract admin functions into separate microservice
- Implement event-driven architecture for processing
- Add API Gateway (AWS API Gateway or Kong)

#### Risk Assessment
- **Scalability Risk:** HIGH - Cannot handle >100 concurrent users
- **Maintainability Risk:** MEDIUM - Codebase will become unmaintainable at 10k LOC
- **Deployment Risk:** CRITICAL - Infrastructure incomplete

### 💻 AGENT 2: CODE QUALITY & REFACTOR ANALYSIS

#### Code Quality Metrics

**Overall Grade: C+**

| Metric | Score | Notes |
|--------|-------|-------|
| Modularity | 6/10 | Adapter pattern good, but no services layer |
| Readability | 7/10 | Clear naming, but complex route handlers |
| Testability | 2/10 | Zero tests, tight coupling prevents unit testing |
| Duplication | 8/10 | Minimal duplication, good abstraction |
| Documentation | 3/10 | No JSDoc, no API docs, minimal comments |

#### Code Smells Identified

**1. God Object: [index.js](backend/index.js)**
- 102 lines doing routing, validation, orchestration, error handling
- Violation: Single Responsibility Principle

**2. Magic Numbers**
```javascript
// backend/index.js:28
limits: { fileSize: 200 * 1024 * 1024 },

// config.js:30
SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS: Number(env.SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS || 300),
```
Should be named constants:
```javascript
const MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES = 200 * 1024 * 1024; // 200 MB
const S3_PRESIGNED_URL_TTL = 300; // 5 minutes
```

**3. Inconsistent Error Handling**
```javascript
// backend/index.js:61 - Returns 404
if (!sermon) return res.status(404).json({ error: "Not found" });

// backend/index.js:68 - Returns 400
if (!parsed.success) return res.status(400).json({ error: "Invalid fields" });

// backend/index.js:69 - Returns 400 with different message
if (!req.file) return res.status(400).json({ error: "Missing file" });
```
No centralized error handler, inconsistent response format.

**4. Missing Validation**
```javascript
// backend/index.js:62-67 - Admin upload has NO auth check
app.post("/api/admin/upload", upload.single("file"), async (req, res) => {
  // Missing: JWT verification, role check, user identity
```

**5. Primitive Obsession**
```javascript
// Dates represented as strings everywhere
date: z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/)
// Should use Date value object with validation
```

**6. Long Parameter Lists**
```javascript
// backend/adapters/db/sqlite.js:71-72
async insertSermon({
  id, title, speaker, date, filename, storageKey, mimetype, size, durationSeconds, createdAt
}) {
```
Should accept a `Sermon` domain object instead.

**7. Frontend: Prop Drilling**
[Library.jsx](frontend/src/pages/Library.jsx) manages too much state (11 useState calls). Should use Context or state management library.

**8. Commented Code Smells**
```javascript
// backend/index.js:6-7
// import { createDbAdapter } from "./adapters/db/index.js";
// import { createBlobAdapter } from "./adapters/blob/index.js";
```
Unused imports left commented instead of removed.

**9. No Environment Validation**
[config.js](backend/config.js) reads env vars but doesn't validate them at startup. Missing vars discovered at runtime.

**10. Docker Multi-Stage Build Issue**
[dockerfile](backend/dockerfile#L18) copies from stage `dhi.io/node:25-alpine3.22` (external dependency) without verification.

**Example Refactor: Upload Endpoint**

**BEFORE ([index.js](backend/index.js#L62-L99)):**
```javascript
app.post("/api/admin/upload", upload.single("file"), async (req, res) => {
  const schema = z.object({
    title: z.string().min(1),
    speaker: z.string().min(1),
    date: z.string().regex(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/)
  });

  const parsed = schema.safeParse(req.body);
  if (!parsed.success) return res.status(400).json({ error: "Invalid fields" });
  if (!req.file) return res.status(400).json({ error: "Missing file" });

  const id = nanoid();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  const { storageKey } = await blob.putAudio({
    id,
    date: parsed.data.date,
    originalName: req.file.originalname,
    mimetype: req.file.mimetype,
    buffer: req.file.buffer,
  });

  await db.insertSermon({
    id,
    title: parsed.data.title,
    speaker: parsed.data.speaker,
    date: parsed.data.date,
    filename: req.file.originalname,
    storageKey,
    mimetype: req.file.mimetype,
    size: req.file.size,
    durationSeconds: null,
    createdAt: now,
  });

  res.json({ ok: true, id });
});
```

**AFTER (Layered):**

```javascript
// api/routes/admin.js
router.post('/upload', 
  authenticateToken,           // NEW: JWT verification
  authorizeRole('admin'),      // NEW: RBAC
  rateLimit({ max: 10 }),      // NEW: Rate limiting
  upload.single('file'),
  AdminController.uploadSermon
);

// api/controllers/AdminController.js
class AdminController {
  static async uploadSermon(req, res, next) {
    try {
      const uploadDto = {
        title: req.body.title,
        speaker: req.body.speaker,
        date: req.body.date,
        file: req.file,
        uploadedBy: req.user.id  // From JWT
      };

      const sermon = await uploadService.createSermon(uploadDto);
      
      // Event: sermon.created
      await eventBus.publish('sermon.created', { sermonId: sermon.id });

      res.status(201).json({ 
        data: sermon.toJSON(),
        message: 'Sermon uploaded successfully' 
      });
    } catch (error) {
      next(error);  // Centralized error handler
    }
  }
}

// services/UploadService.js
class UploadService {
  constructor(sermonRepo, storageAdapter, logger) {
    this.sermonRepo = sermonRepo;
    this.storage = storageAdapter;
    this.logger = logger;
  }

  async createSermon(uploadDto) {
    // 1. Validate DTO
    const validatedData = await this.validateUpload(uploadDto);
    
    // 2. Virus scan (NEW)
    await this.scanForMalware(uploadDto.file.buffer);
    
    // 3. Store file
    const storageKey = await this.storage.putAudio({
      id: validatedData.id,
      date: validatedData.date,
      file: uploadDto.file
    });
    
    // 4. Create domain object
    const sermon = new Sermon({
      ...validatedData,
      storageKey,
      uploadedBy: uploadDto.uploadedBy
    });
    
    // 5. Persist
    await this.sermonRepo.save(sermon);
    
    // 6. Log
    this.logger.info('Sermon created', { sermonId: sermon.id });
    
    return sermon;
  }
}

// domain/Sermon.js
class Sermon {
  constructor(data) {
    this.id = data.id || nanoid();
    this.title = data.title;
    this.speaker = new Speaker(data.speaker);  // Value object
    this.date = new SermonDate(data.date);     // Value object with validation
    this.storageKey = data.storageKey;
    this.metadata = new AudioMetadata(data);
    this.createdAt = data.createdAt || new Date();
    this.uploadedBy = data.uploadedBy;
    
    this.validate();  // Self-validation
  }

  validate() {
    if (!this.title || this.title.trim().length === 0) {
      throw new ValidationError('Title is required');
    }
    if (this.title.length > 200) {
      throw new ValidationError('Title too long');
    }
    // ... more validation
  }

  toJSON() {
    return {
      id: this.id,
      title: this.title,
      speaker: this.speaker.name,
      date: this.date.toISO(),
      // ... etc
    };
  }
}
```

#### Detailed Security Findings

**1. CRITICAL: No Authentication/Authorization**

**Location:** [index.js](backend/index.js#L62)  
**Issue:**
```javascript
app.post("/api/admin/upload", upload.single("file"), async (req, res) => {
  // Anyone can upload 200MB files
```

**Attack Scenario:**
```bash
# Attacker fills your S3 bucket with garbage
for i in {1..1000}; do
  curl -X POST http://your-api.com/api/admin/upload \
    -F "file=@/dev/urandom" \
    -F "title=Junk$i" \
    -F "speaker=Hacker" \
    -F "date=2026-01-01"
done

# Result: $$$$ in S3 costs, service DOS
```

**Remediation:**
```javascript
// 1. Implement JWT-based authentication
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import jwksClient from 'jwks-rsa';

const client = jwksClient({
  jwksUri: `https://cognito-idp.${region}.amazonaws.com/${userPoolId}/.well-known/jwks.json`
});

async function authenticateToken(req, res, next) {
  const token = req.headers.authorization?.split(' ')[1];
  if (!token) return res.status(401).json({ error: 'No token provided' });

  try {
    const decoded = jwt.verify(token, getKey, { algorithms: ['RS256'] });
    req.user = decoded;
    next();
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(401).json({ error: 'Invalid token' });
  }
}

function authorizeRole(role) {
  return (req, res, next) => {
    if (!req.user.groups?.includes(role)) {
      return res.status(403).json({ error: 'Forbidden' });
    }
    next();
  };
}

app.post("/api/admin/upload", 
  authenticateToken, 
  authorizeRole('admin'),
  upload.single("file"), 
  async (req, res) => { /* ... */ }
);
```

**2. CRITICAL: File Upload Vulnerabilities**

**Location:** [index.js](backend/index.js#L26-L32)

**Issues:**
a) **MIME type bypass:**
```javascript
fileFilter: (_req, file, cb) => {
  if (!file.mimetype.startsWith("audio/")) return cb(new Error("Only audio files allowed"));
  cb(null, true);
}
```
Attacker can spoof MIME type:
```bash
curl -X POST /api/admin/upload \
  -F "file=@malware.exe;type=audio/mpeg"  # ← MIME type faked
```

b) **No content validation:** File extension not checked, no magic number verification

c) **No virus scanning:** Malware could be uploaded and served to users

**Remediation:**
```javascript
import crypto from 'crypto';
import fileType from 'file-type';
import { ClamAV } from 'clamav.js';

async function validateAudioFile(buffer) {
  // 1. Magic number check
  const type = await fileType.fromBuffer(buffer);
  const allowedTypes = ['audio/mpeg', 'audio/mp4', 'audio/ogg', 'audio/wav'];
  
  if (!type || !allowedTypes.includes(type.mime)) {
    throw new ValidationError('Invalid audio format');
  }

  // 2. Virus scan
  const clamav = new ClamAV();
  const scanResult = await clamav.scanBuffer(buffer);
  if (scanResult.isInfected) {
    logger.warn('Malware detected', { virus: scanResult.viruses });
    throw new SecurityError('File contains malware');
  }

  // 3. Size validation
  if (buffer.length > 200 * 1024 * 1024) {
    throw new ValidationError('File too large');
  }

  return true;
}
```

`).all(params);  // ✅ Parameterized
```

**Risk:** Sort parameter not validated:

const ALLOWED_SORTS = {
  'date_desc': 'ORDER BY date DESC',
  'date_asc': 'ORDER BY date ASC',
  'title_asc': 'ORDER BY title ASC',
  'title_desc': 'ORDER BY title DESC'
};

const orderSql = ALLOWED_SORTS[sort] || 'ORDER BY date DESC';
```

**4. HIGH: Secrets Management**

**Location:** [config.js](backend/config.js#L20-L24)

**Issue:**
```javascript
DB_PASSWORD: env.DB_PASSWORD,  // ← Plain env var
```

Secrets stored in plaintext in:
- `.env` files (likely in git history)
- Docker Compose files
- GitHub Actions secrets (better, but not rotated)

**Remediation:**
```javascript
// Use AWS Secrets Manager
import { SecretsManagerClient, GetSecretValueCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-secrets-manager';

async function getSecret(secretName) {
  const client = new SecretsManagerClient({ region: config.AWS_REGION });
  const response = await client.send(
    new GetSecretValueCommand({ SecretId: secretName })
  );
  return JSON.parse(response.SecretString);
}

// In config.js
const dbCreds = await getSecret(`${env}/jummahcast/db`);
return {
  // ...
  DB_PASSWORD: dbCreds.password,  // ← From Secrets Manager
  DB_USER: dbCreds.username,
  // Secrets auto-rotate via Lambda
};
```

**Terraform:**
```terraform
resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret" "db_password" {
  name                    = "${var.env}/jummahcast/db"
  recovery_window_in_days = 7  # 7-day recovery window
}

resource "aws_secretsmanager_secret_rotation" "db_password" {
  secret_id           = aws_secretsmanager_secret.db_password.id
  rotation_lambda_arn = aws_lambda_function.rotate_secret.arn

  rotation_rules {
    automatically_after_days = 30
  }
}
```

**Remediation:**
```dockerfile
FROM node:25.2.1-alpine AS build  # ← Official image only

WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production

FROM node:25.2.1-alpine AS runtime

# Security: Run as non-root user
RUN addgroup -g 1001 -S nodejs && \
    adduser -S nodejs -u 1001

WORKDIR /app

# Copy with correct ownership
COPY --from=build --chown=nodejs:nodejs /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --chown=nodejs:nodejs . .

# Switch to non-root user
USER nodejs

EXPOSE 4000

HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
  CMD node -e "require('http').get('http://localhost:4000/health', (r) => process.exit(r.statusCode === 200 ? 0 : 1))"

CMD ["node", "index.js"]
```

**6. MEDIUM: CORS Misconfiguration**

**Location:** [config.js](backend/config.js#L7-L11)

**Issue:**
```javascript
CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS: (env.CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS ||
  "http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:4173")  // ← Hardcoded localhost
```

In production, this needs to be:

- NO wildcards (avoid `*`)
- Credentials support if using cookies

**Remediation:**
```javascript
// config.js
const allowedOrigins = env.CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS?.split(',').map(s => s.trim()) || [];

// Validation
for (const origin of allowedOrigins) {
  if (!origin.match(/^https?:\/\//)) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid CORS origin: ${origin}`);
  }
}

// index.js
app.use(cors({
  origin: (origin, callback) => {
    if (!origin || allowedOrigins.includes(origin)) {
      callback(null, true);
    } else {
      logger.warn('CORS violation', { origin });
      callback(new Error('Not allowed by CORS'));
    }
  },
  credentials: true,
  maxAge: 86400  // Cache preflight for 1 day
}));
```

**7. MEDIUM: No Rate Limiting**

**Attack Scenario:**
```bash
# Brute force admin login (when implemented)
for pw in $(cat passwords.txt); do
  curl -X POST /api/admin/login -d "{\"password\":\"$pw\"}"
done

# Search query DOS
while true; do
  curl '/api/sermons?q=xxxxxxxxxxxxx'
done
```

**Remediation:**
```javascript
import rateLimit from 'express-rate-limit';
import RedisStore from 'rate-limit-redis';
import Redis from 'ioredis';

const redis = new Redis(process.env.REDIS_URL);

// Global rate limit
const globalLimiter = rateLimit({
  store: new RedisStore({ client: redis }),
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,  // 15 minutes
  max: 100,  // 100 requests per 15 min
  standardHeaders: true,
  legacyHeaders: false,
  handler: (req, res) => {
    res.status(429).json({ error: 'Too many requests' });
  }
});

// Strict limiter for auth endpoints
const authLimiter = rateLimit({
  store: new RedisStore({ client: redis }),
  windowMs: 15 * 60 * 1000,
  max: 5,  // 5 attempts per 15 min
  skipSuccessfulRequests: true
});

// Upload rate limit (per user)
const uploadLimiter = rateLimit({
  store: new RedisStore({ client: redis }),
  windowMs: 60 * 60 * 1000,  // 1 hour
  max: 10,  // 10 uploads per hour
  keyGenerator: (req) => req.user.id  // Per authenticated user
});

app.use('/api', globalLimiter);
app.use('/api/admin/login', authLimiter);
app.use('/api/admin/upload', uploadLimiter);
```

**Requires adding Redis to infrastructure:**

  parameter_group_name = "default.redis7"
  port                 = 6379
  subnet_group_name    = aws_elasticache_subnet_group.redis.name
  security_group_ids   = [aws_security_group.redis.id]
}
```

**8. MEDIUM: No Input Sanitization**

**Location:** [index.js](backend/index.js#L41-L44)

**Issue:**
```javascript
const q = (req.query.q || "").toString().trim();
const speaker = (req.query.speaker || "").toString().trim();
// No length limits, no XSS prevention
```

**Attack:**
```bash
curl '/api/sermons?q=<script>alert("XSS")</script>'
# Reflected in logs, potential stored XSS if displayed
```

**Remediation:**
```javascript
import validator from 'validator';
import { z } from 'zod';

const searchSchema = z.object({
  q: z.string().max(100).optional(),
  speaker: z.string().max(100).optional(),
  sort: z.enum(['date_desc', 'date_asc', 'title_asc', 'title_desc']).optional()
});

app.get("/api/sermons", async (req, res) => {
  const parsed = searchSchema.safeParse(req.query);
  if (!parsed.success) {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Invalid query parameters' });
  }

  const { q, speaker, sort } = parsed.data;

  // Sanitize for display (prevent XSS)
  const sanitizedQ = q ? validator.escape(q) : '';
  const sanitizedSpeaker = speaker ? validator.escape(speaker) : '';

  const items = await db.listSermons({ 
    q: sanitizedQ, 
    speaker: sanitizedSpeaker, 
    sort 
  });
  res.json({ items });
});
```

#### Security Architecture Recommendations

**1. Defense in Depth (Layered Security):**

```
Client (React)
  ↓
CloudFront (WAF, DDoS protection)
  ↓
ALB (TLS termination, header injection prevention)
  ↓
API Gateway (Throttling, API key validation)
  ↓
ECS/Fargate (Container isolation, secrets via SSM)
  ↓
VPC (Private subnets, Security Groups, NACLs)
  ↓
RDS (Encryption at rest, IAM auth, VPC isolation)
S3 (Bucket policies, encryption, versioning)
```

**2. IAM Principle of Least Privilege:**

```terraform
# ECS Task Role (runtime permissions)
resource "aws_iam_role" "ecs_task" {
  name = "${var.project}-${var.env}-ecs-task"

  assume_role_policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Action = "sts:AssumeRole"
      Principal = {
        Service = "ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com"
      }
      Effect = "Allow"
    }]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "s3_upload" {
  role = aws_iam_role.ecs_task.id

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Effect = "Allow"
      Action = [
        "s3:PutObject",
        "s3:GetObject"
      ]
      Resource = "${aws_s3_bucket.sermons.arn}/sermons/*"
      # NO DeleteObject, NO ListBucket on root
    }]
  })
}

resource "aws_iam_role_policy" "secrets" {
  role = aws_iam_role.ecs_task.id

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [{
      Effect = "Allow"
      Action = [
        "secretsmanager:GetSecretValue"
      ]
      Resource = [
        aws_secretsmanager_secret.db_password.arn
      ]
      # NO PutSecretValue, NO DeleteSecret
    }]
  })
}
```

**3. Encryption Everywhere:**

| Data State | Current | Required |
|------------|---------|----------|
| In Transit | HTTP (local) | TLS 1.3 (ALB → ECS, RDS, S3) |
| At Rest (DB) | None (SQLite) | RDS encryption with KMS CMK |
| At Rest (Storage) | None (local) | S3 SSE-KMS |
| Secrets | Env vars | AWS Secrets Manager |
| Backups | None | Encrypted RDS snapshots (KMS) |

**Terraform:**
```terraform
resource "aws_kms_key" "jummahcast" {
  description             = "JummahCast encryption key"
  deletion_window_in_days = 10
  enable_key_rotation     = true

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project}-${var.env}-kms"
  }
}

resource "aws_db_instance" "postgres" {
  # ...
  storage_encrypted   = true
  kms_key_id         = aws_kms_key.jummahcast.arn
  
  # Enforce SSL
  parameter_group_name = aws_db_parameter_group.postgres.name
}

resource "aws_db_parameter_group" "postgres" {
  family = "postgres16"

  parameter {
    name  = "rds.force_ssl"
    value = "1"
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration" "sermons" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.sermons.id

  rule {
    apply_server_side_encryption_by_default {
      sse_algorithm     = "aws:kms"
      kms_master_key_id = aws_kms_key.jummahcast.arn
    }
    bucket_key_enabled = true
  }
}
```

    image     = "${aws_ecr_repository.api.repository_url}:${var.image_tag}"
    essential = true

    portMappings = [{
      containerPort = 4000
      protocol      = "tcp"
    }]

    environment = [
      { name = "NODE_ENV", value = var.env },
      { name = "DB_DRIVER", value = "postgres" },
      { name = "BLOB_DRIVER", value = "s3" },
      { name = "AWS_REGION", value = var.region },
      { name = "S3_BUCKET", value = aws_s3_bucket.sermons.id }
    ]

    secrets = [
      {
        name      = "DB_PASSWORD"
        valueFrom = aws_secretsmanager_secret.db_password.arn
      },
      {
        name      = "DB_HOST"
        valueFrom = "${aws_secretsmanager_secret.db_config.arn}:host::"
      }
    ]

    logConfiguration = {
      logDriver = "awslogs"
      options = {
        "awslogs-group"         = aws_cloudwatch_log_group.api.name
        "awslogs-region"        = var.region
        "awslogs-stream-prefix" = "api"
      }
    }

    healthCheck = {
      command     = ["CMD-SHELL", "node -e \"require('http').get('http://localhost:4000/health', (r) => process.exit(r.statusCode === 200 ? 0 : 1))\""]
      interval    = 30
      timeout     = 5
      retries     = 3
      startPeriod = 60
    }
  }])
}

resource "aws_db_instance" "postgres" {
  identifier     = "${var.project}-${var.env}-db"
  engine         = "postgres"

  multi_az               = var.env == "prod" ? true : false
  db_subnet_group_name   = aws_db_subnet_group.main.name
  vpc_security_group_ids = [aws_security_group.db.id]

  backup_retention_period = var.env == "prod" ? 30 : 7
  backup_window           = "03:00-04:00"  # UTC
  maintenance_window      = "sun:04:00-sun:05:00"

  enabled_cloudwatch_logs_exports = ["postgresql", "upgrade"]

  deletion_protection = var.env == "prod" ? true : false
  skip_final_snapshot = var.env == "dev" ? true : false

  performance_insights_enabled = true

resource "aws_db_subnet_group" "main" {
  name       = "${var.project}-${var.env}-db-subnet"
  subnet_ids = module.vpc.private_subnet_ids

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project}-${var.env}-db-subnet-group"
  }
}

# Database schema migration (run once)
resource "null_resource" "db_migration" {
  depends_on = [aws_db_instance.postgres]

  provisioner "local-exec" {
    command = <<-EOT
      psql -h ${aws_db_instance.postgres.address} \
           -U ${aws_db_instance.postgres.username} \
           -d ${aws_db_instance.postgres.db_name} \
           -f ${path.module}/schema/init.sql
    EOT

    environment = {
      PGPASSWORD = random_password.db_password.result
    }
  }
}
```

**schema/init.sql:**
```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sermons (
    id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    speaker TEXT NOT NULL,
    date DATE NOT NULL,
    filename TEXT NOT NULL,
    storage_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    mimetype TEXT NOT NULL,
    size BIGINT NOT NULL,
    duration_seconds INTEGER,
    created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    uploaded_by TEXT  -- Foreign key to users table (future)
);

CREATE INDEX idx_sermons_speaker ON sermons(speaker);
CREATE INDEX idx_sermons_date ON sermons(date DESC);
CREATE INDEX idx_sermons_title ON sermons(title);
CREATE INDEX idx_sermons_created_at ON sermons(created_at DESC);

-- Full-text search (for future)
CREATE INDEX idx_sermons_search ON sermons USING gin(
    to_tsvector('english', title || ' ' || speaker)
);

-- Trigger for updated_at
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    NEW.updated_at = NOW();
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TRIGGER update_sermons_updated_at
    BEFORE UPDATE ON sermons
    FOR EACH ROW
    EXECUTE FUNCTION update_updated_at_column();
```

**3. No Object Storage (S3)**

```terraform
resource "aws_s3_bucket" "sermons" {
  bucket = "${var.project}-${var.env}-sermons"

  tags = {
    Name        = "Sermon Audio Files"
    Environment = var.env
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_versioning" "sermons" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.sermons.id

  versioning_configuration {
    status = "Enabled"  # Protect against accidental deletion
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_server_side_encryption_configuration" "sermons" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.sermons.id

  rule {
    apply_server_side_encryption_by_default {
      sse_algorithm     = "aws:kms"
      kms_master_key_id = aws_kms_key.jummahcast.arn
    }
    bucket_key_enabled = true
  }
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block" "sermons" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.sermons.id

  block_public_acls       = true
  block_public_policy     = true
  ignore_public_acls      = true
  restrict_public_buckets = true
}

resource "aws_s3_bucket_lifecycle_configuration" "sermons" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.sermons.id

  rule {
    id     = "archive-old-versions"
    status = "Enabled"

    noncurrent_version_transition {
      noncurrent_days = 30
      storage_class   = "GLACIER"
    }

    noncurrent_version_expiration {
      noncurrent_days = 90  # Delete old versions after 90 days
    }
  }

  rule {
    id     = "transition-to-ia"
    status = "Enabled"

    transition {
      days          = 90  # Files not accessed in 90 days → Infrequent Access
      storage_class = "STANDARD_IA"
    }
  }
}

# Bucket policy: Allow CloudFront OAC + ECS Task Role
resource "aws_s3_bucket_policy" "sermons" {
  bucket = aws_s3_bucket.sermons.id

  policy = jsonencode({
    Version = "2012-10-17"
    Statement = [
      {
        Sid    = "AllowCloudFrontOAC"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Principal = {
          Service = "cloudfront.amazonaws.com"
        }
        Action   = "s3:GetObject"
        Resource = "${aws_s3_bucket.sermons.arn}/*"
        Condition = {
          StringEquals = {
            "AWS:SourceArn" = aws_cloudfront_distribution.cdn.arn
          }
        }
      },
      {
        Sid    = "AllowECSTaskRole"
        Effect = "Allow"
        Principal = {
          AWS = aws_iam_role.ecs_task.arn
        }
        Action = [
          "s3:PutObject",
          "s3:GetObject"
        ]
        Resource = "${aws_s3_bucket.sermons.arn}/sermons/*"
      }
    ]
  })
}

# HTTP → HTTPS redirect

  port              = 80
  protocol          = "HTTP"

    type = "redirect"

      port        = "443"

    }

  load_balancer_arn = aws_lb.main.arn

**5. No CDN (CloudFront)**

```terraform
resource "aws_cloudfront_origin_access_control" "s3" {
  name                              = "${var.project}-${var.env}-oac"
  origin_access_control_origin_type = "s3"
  signing_behavior                  = "always"
  signing_protocol                  = "sigv4"
}

resource "aws_cloudfront_distribution" "cdn" {
  enabled             = true
  is_ipv6_enabled     = true
  comment             = "JummahCast CDN - ${var.env}"
  default_root_object = "index.html"
  price_class         = var.env == "prod" ? "PriceClass_All" : "PriceClass_100"

  # Origin 1: S3 (audio files)
  origin {
    domain_name              = aws_s3_bucket.sermons.bucket_regional_domain_name
    origin_id                = "S3-Sermons"
    origin_access_control_id = aws_cloudfront_origin_access_control.s3.id

    origin_shield {
      enabled              = var.env == "prod" ? true : false
      origin_shield_region = var.region
    }
  }

  # Origin 2: ALB (API)
  origin {
    domain_name = aws_lb.main.dns_name
    origin_id   = "ALB-API"

    custom_origin_config {
      http_port              = 80
      https_port             = 443
      origin_protocol_policy = "https-only"
      origin_ssl_protocols   = ["TLSv1.2"]
    }
  }

  # Behavior 1: API requests
  ordered_cache_behavior {
    path_pattern     = "/api/*"
    target_origin_id = "ALB-API"

    allowed_methods  = ["GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS", "PUT", "POST", "PATCH", "DELETE"]
    cached_methods   = ["GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"]
    compress         = true

    viewer_protocol_policy = "https-only"
    min_ttl                = 0
    default_ttl            = 0
    max_ttl                = 0  # Don't cache API responses

    forwarded_values {
      query_string = true
      headers      = ["Authorization", "Origin"]

      cookies {
        forward = "all"
      }
    }
  }

  # Behavior 2: Sermon streaming (S3)
  ordered_cache_behavior {
    path_pattern     = "/sermons/*"
    target_origin_id = "S3-Sermons"

    allowed_methods  = ["GET", "HEAD"]
    cached_methods   = ["GET", "HEAD"]
    compress         = false  # Audio already compressed

    viewer_protocol_policy = "https-only"
    min_ttl                = 86400   # 1 day
    default_ttl            = 604800  # 7 days
    max_ttl                = 31536000  # 1 year

    forwarded_values {
      query_string = false

      cookies {
        forward = "none"
      }
    }
  }

  # Default behavior: Frontend (S3)
  default_cache_behavior {
    target_origin_id = "S3-Frontend"  # (Need to add frontend origin)

    allowed_methods  = ["GET", "HEAD"]
    cached_methods   = ["GET", "HEAD"]
    compress         = true

    viewer_protocol_policy = "redirect-to-https"
    min_ttl                = 0
    default_ttl            = 3600    # 1 hour
    max_ttl                = 86400   # 1 day

    forwarded_values {
      query_string = false

      cookies {
        forward = "none"
      }
    }
  }

  restrictions {
    geo_restriction {
      restriction_type = "none"
    }
  }

  viewer_certificate {
    acm_certificate_arn      = aws_acm_certificate.main.arn  # Must be us-east-1!
    ssl_support_method       = "sni-only"
    minimum_protocol_version = "TLSv1.2_2021"
  }

  web_acl_id = aws_wafv2_web_acl.main.arn  # WAF protection

  logging_config {
    bucket          = aws_s3_bucket.cloudfront_logs.bucket_domain_name
    include_cookies = false
    prefix          = "cloudfront/"
  }

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project}-${var.env}-cdn"
  }
}
```

resource "aws_route53_zone" "main" {

    name                   = aws_cloudfront_distribution.cdn.domain_name
    zone_id                = aws_cloudfront_distribution.cdn.hosted_zone_id
    evaluate_target_health = false

}

# ACM certificate (must be in us-east-1 for CloudFront)
resource "aws_acm_certificate" "main" {
  provider          = aws.us_east_1  # Alias provider
  domain_name       = var.domain_name
  validation_method = "DNS"

  subject_alternative_names = [
    "www.${var.domain_name}",
    "api.${var.domain_name}"
  ]

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }

  tags = {
    Name = "${var.project}-${var.env}-cert"
  }
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "cert_validation" {
  for_each = {
    for dvo in aws_acm_certificate.main.domain_validation_options : dvo.domain_name => {
      name   = dvo.resource_record_name
      record = dvo.resource_record_value
      type   = dvo.resource_record_type
    }
  }

  allow_overwrite = true
  name            = each.value.name
  records         = [each.value.record]
  ttl             = 60
  type            = each.value.type
  zone_id         = aws_route53_zone.main.zone_id
}

# 🔍 JUMMAHCAST-APP: COMPREHENSIVE SYSTEM AUDIT

**Audit Date:** March 21, 2026  
**System Type:** Audio Streaming Platform for Religious Content  
**Current Stage:** MVP / Early Development

---

## 1. SYSTEM OVERVIEW

### Current State
JummahCast-App is a **monolithic web application** for streaming and managing Jummah (Friday prayer) lectures. The system uses:

- **Frontend:** React 19 + Vite (SPA)
- **Backend:** Node.js + Express (REST API)
- **Database:** Adapter pattern (SQLite for local, PostgreSQL for production)
- **Storage:** Adapter pattern (Local filesystem or AWS S3)
- **Infrastructure:** Partial AWS deployment via Terraform (VPC only)
- **Containerization:** Docker (backend only)
- **CI/CD:** GitHub Actions (build + push to ECR)

### Architecture Diagram (Current)
```

### Key Characteristics
- **Deployment Model:** Local development only, AWS infra incomplete
- **State:** Stateful (stores files locally or expects S3)
- **Scale:** Single-instance, no horizontal scaling capability
- **Auth:** None (commented "Coming next: Cognito")
- **Public Access:** Not production-ready

## 2. 🚨 CRITICAL ISSUES (Top 10)

| # | Issue | Severity | Impact | Component |
|---|-------|----------|--------|-----------|
| 1 | **No Authentication/Authorization** | CRITICAL | Anyone can upload 200MB files, DOS attack vector | Backend API |
| 2 | **Missing Input Validation on Upload** | CRITICAL | File type bypass, malicious uploads, injection risks | /api/admin/upload |
| 3 | **No Rate Limiting** | CRITICAL | Resource exhaustion, costs spiralling (S3/RDS) | Backend |
| 4 | **Incomplete Infrastructure** | CRITICAL | Cannot deploy to production, no compute/storage | Terraform |
| 5 | **Hardcoded CORS Origins** | HIGH | Cannot change without rebuild, security risk | config.js |
| 6 | **No Logging/Monitoring** | HIGH | Cannot debug production issues, no observability | Entire system |
| 7 | **No Database Migration Strategy** | HIGH | Manual schema changes break deployment | DB layer |
| 8 | **Docker Security Issues** | HIGH | Running as root, commented healthcheck, image from untrusted registry | Dockerfile |
| 9 | **No Secrets Management** | HIGH | DB passwords in env vars, no rotation, no vault | Config |
| 10 | **Missing Error Handling** | MEDIUM | Crashes expose stack traces, poor UX | Backend routes |

## 3. 🧩 AGENT REPORTS

### 🧱 AGENT 1: ARCHITECTURE ANALYSIS

#### Current Architecture Pattern
**Monolithic N-Tier with Adapter Pattern**
- Presentation (React SPA)
- API Layer (Express REST)
- Business Logic (Minimal, in route handlers)
- Data Access (Adapter abstraction over SQLite/Postgres)
- Infrastructure (Adapter abstraction over Local/S3)

#### Findings

**✅ Strengths:**
1. **Clean adapter pattern** for database and storage portability
2. **Separation of concerns** between frontend/backend
3. **Environment-driven configuration** allows dev/prod parity
4. **Simple data model** appropriate for MVP scope

**❌ Weaknesses:**

1. **Fat Controllers Anti-Pattern**
   - All business logic in route handlers ([index.js](backend/index.js#L41-L99))
   - No service layer, no domain models
   - Violates Single Responsibility Principle

2. **No Domain Layer**
   - Missing entities: `Sermon`, `Speaker`, `User`
   - No validation logic encapsulation
   - Database models directly exposed to HTTP layer

3. **Tight Coupling**
   - Frontend directly constructs stream URLs ([api.js](frontend/src/lib/api.js#L20))
   - No API versioning (`/api/v1/...`)
   - Hard to evolve without breaking changes

4. **Missing Architectural Components:**
   - No message queue (for async processing like thumbnails, transcription)
   - No caching layer (Redis for sermon metadata, speaker lists)
   - No CDN integration (CloudFront for audio streaming)
   - No search engine (Elasticsearch for full-text search)

5. **Scalability Issues:**
   - Stateful local storage violates 12-factor app
   - No session management (future auth will be problematic)
   - Database connection pooling config is hardcoded

6. **Infrastructure Gaps:**
   - VPC exists but no compute resources
   - No IaC for RDS, S3, ECS, ALB, Route53
   - No multi-AZ deployment
   - No disaster recovery plan

#### Architecture Recommendations

**Immediate (Phase 1):**
```
Monolith Refactor with Layered Architecture:

frontend/
backend/
  ├── src/
  │   ├── domain/          # Entities & value objects
  │   │   ├── Sermon.js
  │   │   ├── Speaker.js
  │   │   └── User.js
  │   ├── services/        # Business logic
  │   │   ├── SermonService.js
  │   │   └── AuthService.js
  │   ├── repositories/    # Data access
  │   │   └── SermonRepository.js
  │   ├── adapters/        # External integrations
  │   │   ├── db/
  │   │   └── storage/
  │   ├── api/             # HTTP layer
  │   │   ├── routes/
  │   │   ├── middleware/
  │   │   └── controllers/
  │   └── infrastructure/  # Config, logging
```

**Medium-term (Phase 2):**
- Extract admin functions into separate microservice
- Implement event-driven architecture for processing
- Add API Gateway (AWS API Gateway or Kong)

#### Risk Assessment
- **Scalability Risk:** HIGH - Cannot handle >100 concurrent users
- **Maintainability Risk:** MEDIUM - Codebase will become unmaintainable at 10k LOC
- **Deployment Risk:** CRITICAL - Infrastructure incomplete

### 💻 AGENT 2: CODE QUALITY & REFACTOR ANALYSIS

#### Code Quality Metrics

**Overall Grade: C+**

| Metric | Score | Notes |
|--------|-------|-------|
| Modularity | 6/10 | Adapter pattern good, but no services layer |
| Readability | 7/10 | Clear naming, but complex route handlers |
| Testability | 2/10 | Zero tests, tight coupling prevents unit testing |
| Duplication | 8/10 | Minimal duplication, good abstraction |
| Documentation | 3/10 | No JSDoc, no API docs, minimal comments |

#### Code Smells Identified

**1. God Object: [index.js](backend/index.js)**
- 102 lines doing routing, validation, orchestration, error handling
- Violation: Single Responsibility Principle

**2. Magic Numbers**
```javascript
// backend/index.js:28
limits: { fileSize: 200 * 1024 * 1024 },

// config.js:30
SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS: Number(env.SIGNED_URL_TTL_SECONDS || 300),
```
Should be named constants:
```javascript
const MAX_FILE_SIZE_BYTES = 200 * 1024 * 1024; // 200 MB
const S3_PRESIGNED_URL_TTL = 300; // 5 minutes
```

**3. Inconsistent Error Handling**
```javascript
// backend/index.js:61 - Returns 404
if (!sermon) return res.status(404).json({ error: "Not found" });

No centralized error handler, inconsistent response format.

// services/UploadService.js
class UploadService {
  constructor(sermonRepo, storageAdapter, logger) {
    this.sermonRepo = sermonRepo;
    this.storage = storageAdapter;
    this.logger = logger;
  }

  async createSermon(uploadDto) {
    // 1. Validate DTO
    const validatedData = await this.validateUpload(uploadDto);
    
    // 2. Virus scan (NEW)
    await this.scanForMalware(uploadDto.file.buffer);
    
    // 3. Store file
    const storageKey = await this.storage.putAudio({
      id: validatedData.id,
      date: validatedData.date,
      file: uploadDto.file
    });
    
    // 4. Create domain object

      ...validatedData,
      storageKey,
      uploadedBy: uploadDto.uploadedBy
    });
    
    // 5. Persist
    await this.sermonRepo.save(sermon);
    
    // 6. Log
    this.logger.info('Sermon created', { sermonId: sermon.id });
    
    return sermon;
  }
}

// domain/Sermon.js
class Sermon {
  constructor(data) {
    this.id = data.id || nanoid();
    this.title = data.title;
    this.speaker = new Speaker(data.speaker);  // Value object
    this.date = new SermonDate(data.date);     // Value object with validation
    this.storageKey = data.storageKey;
    this.metadata = new AudioMetadata(data);
    this.createdAt = data.createdAt || new Date();
    this.uploadedBy = data.uploadedBy;
    
    this.validate();  // Self-validation
  }

  validate() {
    if (!this.title || this.title.trim().length === 0) {
      throw new ValidationError('Title is required');
    }
    if (this.title.length > 200) {
      throw new ValidationError('Title too long');
    }
    // ... more validation
  }

  toJSON() {
    return {
      id: this.id,
      title: this.title,
      speaker: this.speaker.name,
      date: this.date.toISO(),
      // ... etc
    };
  }
}
